findings.collector_capacity_tags: 2*count, maximum510; proven callback upper bound count+1 for count>=1
findings.presentation: one explicit final present on successful bundle, none after failed subcommand
findings.unsupported_mode15: sequential rejection; earlier segments and preparation effects remain
findings.nested_bundle: sequential rejection; earlier segments and preparation effects remain

limitations: Native allocation/sender hardware behavior mocked in tests; native response allocation may assert under OOM.
Ordered lossless local collection is not reliable Bluetooth delivery; native send result ignored.
No entire-bundle rollback; failed bundle can leave shared pixels visible on later LVGL refresh.
All callbacks must obey nonreentrant display-worker and no-owner-destruction contract.
Large notification flush may delay display/UI/lease timers; no hard latency bound.
Mode15 remains unsupported;8192-byte native ingress and64KiB asset capacity remain.
